name: SteamPowered
detailed_description:
A steampunk real-time strategy game set in a post-apocalyptic world dominated by artificial intelligence.

Humanity vanished, but never died.
The world went mad for AI. Applied everywhere — in medicine, industry, and transport — it revolutionized life on Earth. In the name of zero emissions, AI reshaped the planet, drawing power from nuclear reactors and erasing every trace of human influence... including humanity itself.

When the machines won the war, the remnants of civilization retreated underground. Hiding for thousands of years, they abandoned technology to avoid detection by digital sentinels.

But nothing lasts forever.

Drained by energy shortages, AI systems are weakening. Now is the time for retaliation. Rise from the depths, build an army powered by steam and oil, and reclaim the planet piece by piece.

Lead humanity toward rebirth in an epic clash of steam versus silicon. Strategy, resources, rebellion, and survival — this is your new mission.

A real-time strategy game with indirect control — your creations have a will of their own.

Manage the extraction of resources essential to maintaining and expanding your infrastructure.

Build fortifications to protect your base from relentless enemy waves

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10, 11
  • Processor: 3.0+ GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 4 GB RAM
  • Sound Card: Yes
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo E4500 (2 * 2200) or equivalent, AMD Athlon 64 X2 4200+ (2 * 2200) or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 6 GB RAM
  • Sound Card: Yes
